description.value: Kafka's Coffee is a Vancouver-based specialty coffee roaster with multiple locations; the Great Northern Way outpost doubles as the company's bakery hub, serving house-made breads, pastries, and a full breakfast and lunch menu from a sun-soaked patio on the Emily Carr University and Centre for Digital Media campus. Espresso is pulled on a custom-modified Synesso machine using beans sourced directly from farmers and roasted weekly in Vancouver. The space also functions as a community arts venue, hosting rotating solo and group exhibitions by local artists.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 36m; stands (12 spaces) at 56m; rack at 73m. Total: 12 spaces.

The website describes a 'sun soaked patio' and a menu with clearly vegetarian items (avocado toast, granola, toast), but does not explicitly mention bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or Wi-Fi, so those remain null despite the OSM internet_access=wlan tag.
